paragraphs.text: Parents today often fill their children’s weeks with lessons, clubs and training sessions. The intention is good, and I do not doubt that many children enjoy these activities. Yet I believe something valuable is being lost.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Unstructured play, in which children decide for themselves what to do, teaches them to solve problems, negotiate with friends and cope with boredom. None of these skills appears on a certificate, which may be why they are so easily overlooked.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Some parents say that organised activities keep children safe and away from screens. That is a fair point, but the choice is not simply between a football club and a tablet. A park or a back garden offers both freedom and fresh air.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: I am not suggesting that clubs should be abandoned. One or two activities a week can give a child real skills and confidence. The problem begins when every evening is booked and a free afternoon is treated as a wasted one.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: I do not doubt that many children enjoy these activities
items.prompt: The writer doubts that children enjoy organised activities.

explanation.en: “I do not doubt that many children enjoy these activities” — the writer does not doubt it at all → NO.
explanation.kk: «I do not doubt that many children enjoy these activities» — автор, керісінше, күмәнданбайды → NO.
explanation.ru: «I do not doubt that many children enjoy these activities» — автор, наоборот, не сомневается → NO.

items.quote: teaches them to solve problems, negotiate with friends and cope with boredom
items.prompt: The writer thinks unstructured play develops useful skills.

explanation.en: Free play “teaches them to solve problems, negotiate with friends and cope with boredom” — the writer sees these as valuable skills → YES.
explanation.kk: Еркін ойын «teaches them to solve problems, negotiate with friends and cope with boredom» — автор бұл дағдыларды құнды деп санайды → YES.
explanation.ru: Свободная игра «teaches them to solve problems, negotiate with friends and cope with boredom» — автор считает эти навыки ценными → YES.

items.quote: None of these skills appears on a certificate
items.prompt: The writer believes schools should set less homework.

explanation.en: The text is about clubs, lessons and free play; school homework is never mentioned. The writer’s view on it is unknown → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Мәтін үйірмелер, сабақтар және еркін ойын туралы; мектептегі үй тапсырмасы туралы бір сөз жоқ. Автордың бұл туралы пікірі белгісіз → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: Текст о клубах, занятиях и свободной игре; о школьных домашних заданиях — ни слова. Что автор думает о них, неизвестно → NOT GIVEN.

items.prompt: The writer dismisses the view that organised activities keep children safe.

explanation.en: To the safety argument the writer says “That is a fair point” and only then adds “but”. He acknowledges the idea rather than dismissing it → NO.
explanation.kk: Қауіпсіздік туралы дәлелге автор «That is a fair point» дейді де, содан кейін ғана «but» қосады. Ол бұл ойды мойындайды, жоққа шығармайды → NO.
explanation.ru: На довод о безопасности автор отвечает «That is a fair point» и лишь потом добавляет «but». Он признаёт мысль, а не отбрасывает её → NO.

items.quote: One or two activities a week can give a child real skills and confidence
items.prompt: The writer believes that one or two activities a week can benefit a child.

explanation.en: The writer is not against clubs as such: “One or two activities a week can give a child real skills and confidence”. Skills and confidence are exactly the benefit → YES.
explanation.kk: Автор үйірмеге мүлде қарсы емес: «One or two activities a week can give a child real skills and confidence». Дағды мен сенімділік — балаға пайда деген сол → YES.
explanation.ru: Автор не против кружков вообще: «One or two activities a week can give a child real skills and confidence». Навыки и уверенность — это и есть польза для ребёнка → YES.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. Do the following statements agree with the claims of the writer in the reading passage? Write YES if the statement agrees with the claims of the writer, NO if the statement contradicts the claims of the writer, or NOT GIVEN if it is impossible to say what the writer thinks about this.
